_note: Nicknames and short forms, mapping what people actually type to the exact
characterName used in episodes.json. This file is ORIGINAL to edl-cut and is
not part of Jeffrey Lancaster's dataset — that dataset carries no general
alias field, so short forms like 'dany' cannot be resolved from it.
Keys are matched case-insensitively. Add your own freely; unknown keys are
ignored, so a typo here cannot break resolution.
